signal: A quote fresh at snapshot capture could be >120 seconds old by the time a long-running Phase 2 child completed and the runner published PAPER_RECEIPT_VERIFIED.
root_cause: validate_quote_exchange_times compared exchFeedTime only to raw captured_at, not to final publication time. CHILD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS permits up to 600 seconds.
upstream_downstream: Read-only quote -> snapshot capture -> long Phase2 child -> receipt/hash verification -> proof copy -> PAPER_RECEIPT_VERIFIED. Capture-time freshness alone does not guarantee publication-time freshness.
impact: P1 false-green freshness risk in cloud PAPER evidence. No independently observed live broker or deployed runtime incident.
prevention_hypothesis: Require explicit timezone-aware checked_at, reject any quote older than 120 seconds at checked_at, and repeat the check immediately before publishing success.

test_first.evidence: New test-first cases failed on missing checked_at keyword and missing main call; exact-head job pytest step failed.

patch.behavior: Fail closed if exchange quote is stale at initial validation or immediately before verified status. Status carries quote_freshness_checked_at, which is a local self-reported timestamp.

cases: fresh at capture but stale at publication rejected
